title: Building Layout Explorer: unit mix controls
description:
A client hands you a unit mix. Then comes the slow part: producing layouts that hit it while balancing circulation, core placement, and efficiency.

It takes days, and the number of options you can show is set by how much time you have, not by how many are worth seeing.

The Building Layout Explorer in Forma Site Design generates and compares multifamily layouts against a client’s unit mix. The newest version, now rolling out in the open beta, adds the ability to control that unit mix yourself.
This is early research, and what it produces today is a starting point for exploration, not something to rely on directly.

We announced it at Autodesk University. Read about it and other announcements in our blog: https://lnkd.in/eR46hvhA
